title: Style guides and terminology reach AI translation
summary: Style guides, terminology-aware AI translation, TM file import and export, a Cosmos LLM node and a choice of lip-sync models.

sections.title: Translation Memory
sections.note: AI translation now follows your style guides and terminology.

items.body: Upload up to 10 files and the rules are extracted for you
Approved terms are binding, forbidden ones never used
Import and export TMX, XLIFF, XLSX, CSV and TSV
VitraTM covers all 1,175 languages in the catalogue
A generic LLM node: pick the model, modalities and instructions
Text and Office inputs can feed image and video models
Refreshed GPT, Gemini and image model catalogue
Choose your lip-sync model, with its price shown on export
OpenAI is the default for new image translation and Image Creator users
Office translation handles CSV and XLSX
Organization API keys for agents and scripts
Bengali and Hindi terms are matched
Languages that shared a name resolve to the right code
Lip-sync exports use the organization's chosen model
Large Gemini batch translations no longer fail after payment
